notices: Please be informed that, in accordance with the implementation of the Immigration Department of Malaysia's new visa application policy, effective 1 October 2026, any application in “New Application” or “Pending Payment” status for more than 7 working days will automatically expire and be removed from the “My Application(s)” list. This policy applies to all applications, including those created prior to 1 September 2026.

Effective 1 September 2026, Multiple Entry Visa (MEV) will no longer be available for all nationalities and will be limited to 31 eligible nationalities for the following purposes: i. Fly & Cruise ii. Business iii. Medical Treatment iv. Wedding Tourism

All foreign nationals are REQUIRED to register the Malaysia Digital Arrival Card (MDAC) within 3 days before arriving in Malaysia. Passport must be valid for at least six (6) months from the date of entry.
Before you submit your application, make sure your passport-sized photo complies with the specification below. Non-compliant photos will lead to rejection of your application.
VTR Application: Plain white background, with no border or frame around the photo.
Head height of 30–35mm, measured from chin to crown.

VTR Visa Without Reference: Passport sized studio photo. Passport biodata page with passport validity more than six (6) months from travel date to Malaysia. Passport page with previous passport number. Round trip flight ticket/ proof of journey. Proof of paid accommodation/hotel booking. Proof of financial support. Birth certificate for minor applicants. Other supporting documents.
